ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: in the figure is a schematic diagram of the tomato life cycle, with multiple stages connected by yellow arrows. The lower left shows red tomatoes and a cut tomato, with scattered seeds beside them; from this stage of the fruit releasing seeds, a yellow arrow points upward to the brownish-yellow, withered and dried plant at the upper left. Reasoning: the question asks for the next stage after the fruit releases seeds. Looking along the arrow starting from the lower-left tomato and seed stage, the arrow points to the withered plant, therefore the next stage is plant death.
